mapper.select: SELECT * FROM (SELECT A.* , (SELECT USER_ID FROM TB_USER U WHERE U.DEL_YN = 'N' AND U.USER_SEQ = A.REG_USER_SEQ) USER_ID FROM TB_BOARD A WHERE A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.BOARD_SEQ = #{boardSeq}) TB
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_BOARD(BOARD_TP, BOARD_NM, BOARD_SMP_DERPN, BOARD_DERPN, RLS_YN, USE_YN, DEL_YN, REG_USER_SEQ, REG_IP) VALUES (#{boardTp}, #{boardNm}, #{boardSmpDerpn}, #{boardDerpn}, #{rlsYn}, #{useYn}, #{delYn}, #{regUserSeq}, #{regIp});
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_BOARD SET BOARD_NM=#{boardNm}, BOARD_SMP_DERPN=#{boardSmpDerpn}, BOARD_DERPN=#{boardDerpn}, BOARD_TP=#{boardTp}, RLS_YN=#{rlsYn}, MDFCN_DT=NOW(), MDFCN_USER_SEQ=#{mdfcnUserSeq}, MDFCN_IP=#{mdfcnIp} WHERE BOARD_SEQ = #{boardSeq}
UPDATE TB_BOARD SET DEL_YN = #{delYn}, DEL_IP=#{delIp}, DEL_USER_SEQ = #{delUserSeq}, DEL_DT = NOW() WHERE BOARD_SEQ = #{boardSeq} AND BOARD_TP = #{boardTp}
